items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Legen Sie nicht binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung Einspruch ein, wird dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig, und die Geldbuße kann vollstreckt werden.
items.computation: This is a formal Zustellung (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO), so no statutory 'deemed delivery' fiction applies; the start is the actual service date printed on the returned Zustellungsurkunde (page 2): 'zugestellt am 18.12.20[26]' = 18 Dec 2026 (Friday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so the two-week Einspruchsfrist (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG, § 43 StPO via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) starts 19 Dec 2026 and runs 14 days to Fri 1 Jan 2027 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 1 Jan 2027 is Neujahr, a public holiday nationwide, so under § 43 StPO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Mon 4 Jan 2027 (confirmed by the compute_deadline tool).

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Den Gesamtbetrag zahlen Sie bitte, sobald dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig ist – spätestens zwei Wochen danach – unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das Konto DE67 5205 0000 0000 0106 00.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (finality) is reached the day after the Einspruch period expires without an objection having been filed, i.e. the day after 4 Jan 2027 = 5 Jan 2027 (assuming no Einspruch is lodged). The letter sets the outer payment limit at 'spätestens zwei Wochen danach' (at the latest two weeks after that). Counting from 5 Jan 2027 (day not counted, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), two weeks later is Tue 19 Jan 2027 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB), which is a normal working day in NRW, so no shift applies (confirmed by the compute_deadline tool). The total due is 128,50 € (100,00 € Geldbuße + 25,00 € Gebühr + 3,50 € Auslagen).

warnings: The service date on the returned Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) is printed as 'zugestellt am 18.12.20' with the year cut off; it was read as 18.12.2026 because that fits the document date (14.12.2026) and today's date, but the original envelope should be checked to confirm the exact service date, since both the Einspruch deadline and the payment deadline are counted from it.

The payment deadline (2027-01-19) assumes no Einspruch is filed and that the decision becomes final the day after the Einspruch period (4 Jan 2027) expires; filing an Einspruch would stop both the Rechtskraft and this payment obligation.

Before paying, verify the account holder name behind IBAN DE67 5205 0000 0000 0106 00 matches the Landesverwaltungsamt Musterhöhe – Zentrale Bußgeldstelle, as is good practice for any payment demand, even though the IBAN itself is a validly formatted German account.
